input_contract: Any IEEE-39 PMU folder with Bus*.csv files and TIMESTAMP-aligned PMU measurement columns.
output_contract: predictions.csv with TIMESTAMP, Bus, Predicted_Event, Predicted_Location.
notes: This bundle is bus-agnostic: it does not require the fixed RAW001 PMU bus set.
Thresholds are deliberately stored outside code so they can be recalibrated without changing the reviewer entrypoint.
